pr_body:
When creating a model hosted by Elastic ensure the download task has been created before responding to the PUT

Closes #102948
pr_comments: Thanks for re-enabling the test @maxhniebergall I didn't realise it was muted

I suspect the start action is being called before the download task is created, it hits this line of code:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ml/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ml/action/TransportStartTrainedModelDeploymentAction.java#L564

And figures the task is complete and starts the model. In the background the model downloader has started and created a partial definition which causes the failure.

The problem is in the PUT where if `wait_for_completion: false` the listener is triggered right away. 

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ml/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ml/action/TransportPutTrainedModelAction.java#L486

The `LoadTrainedModelPackageAction` action should trigger the listener after it has created the task. In fact it already does that:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ml-package-loader/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ml/packageloader/action/TransportLoadTrainedModelPackage.java#L111

So the fix could be as simple as deleting the listener trigger code at 

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ml/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ml/action/TransportPutTrainedModelAction.java#L486
I haven't been able to reproduce this error even after running dozens of iterations with -Dtests.iters. I'm going to create a pull request with @davidkyle's proposed fix anyway.
